verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents creating custom frameworks or custom controls with user-defined tests and evidence requirements. What it does show is adjacent: Custom Integrations that ingest data from unsupported tools, which Secureframe then tests itself; custom policies; custom fields for Personnel and Tasks; and MCP access to manage existing controls, tests and frameworks. None of these is the story's capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a security engineer, I can add custom frameworks and custom controls with my own tests and evidence requirements alongside the built-in ones
